segments.text: >> Welcome. My name is Blazej Kotelko and in this short session we'll talk about user experience and changes that you see on your screen when working with Business Central.

First thing that you will notice is the new icon Business Central icon updated now in this year uh that aligns with all the other changes across Microsoft. You will see a lot of different uh icon changes across uh other Microsoft products and that also applies to Business Central.

You will see this new icon when you're working with Business Central through the browser or when you are accessing Business Central through a mobile app or Teams app. Wherever you have Business Central, this new icon uh is with you.

But of course the changes in the icon uh is not the only thing that we have done. And we mostly have uh focused on uh working with agents on on experience when you are working with agents in Business Central.
So let's start with that. You will see a new task pane for agents and dedicated task pane that right now is uh separated from the rest of the experience
uh and allows you to work with agents that are built in in the product sales order and payables agents but also those custom agents that can be now built by you or or your partners.
There are other sessions in this event that talk about specifically about agents and also those custom agents uh but I just wanted to highlight this new experience where tasks related to agents
uh are managed in this special uh dedicated task pane. Uh when we're looking at this task pane we we have activities related to all of those agents and sometimes agent needs some

uh input from users uh and that's where other experiences also um are important. So one of those changes you will see is a new column on lists and especially uh important when you are looking at documents that were created by agents.
This new system columns give you a uh information a short information about who created a record and and who uh modified the record.
And of course uh is available for you on all lists not only uh lists that uh talk about documents created by agents. So it might be quite useful uh for all the other use cases.

Uh another change that you will see is the review bar that now shows up in uh in the context of agents specifically. So when the there is a document or a page that that requires a human intervention or a page that was changed by the agent and now
a human operator would like to understand what was changed and when uh that review bar uh gives you additional um input into what what has changed.

So let's see those little things in a demo. Here I am in my Business Central and I can see that my agents already are working for me. As you can see right now I have this dedicated task pane and that task pane shows me all the action activities from the agent.
If I click on a specific um action and I have a purchase invoice to review and I can see this um review bar right now on screen.
So if I would navigate to this uh document uh from Business Central, I would also get to to that review bar and I will be able to review changes done by the agent.
If I would go to my document list let's go to sales quotes. As you can see here I have this new column created updated by.

You can turn this column on and off using a new setting here in the list settings. And then here you can see which record was created by a sales order agent or another agent and which record was modified maybe by uh a user.
This gives you a very quick access to information about what was happening with a specific document. Uh very interesting changes related to agents and uh and UI.

Another thing that you will see uh in the product is a new action to cancel all agent tasks. This is specifically very important if you misconfigure your agent or uh for some reason your agent is stuck and you have plenty of tasks.

Uh of course so far you were also able to uh navigate to each task and cancel uh cancel it but right now you can cancel everything uh in one go and we have this stop all tasks uh action available right now in this dedicated task pane.
Uh we are actually also working on some changes related to this task pane and we'll be adding more actions like that uh allowing you to control um all the tasks coming from agents.
So uh please uh please be mindful about about those uh those uh improvements coming your way. You will also see some changes in the product that reflect our new feedback experience.
When we are asking for feedback either uh randomly we actually asking feed for feedback for customers from time to time um and we are looking forward to feedback coming from customers

uh that uh that are running Business Central in the cloud. But we also have this on-demand feature where you can provide feedback and then in some uh areas of the product you will see this new uh feedback button where you can provide a more detailed comments and even attach a screenshot attach
a document and that way send us more information about your experience with Business Central. That helps uh tremendously uh improve Business Central over the long run.
That's it from my side. Thank you very much. Have a look at all the resources available for you uh online and uh let's stay in touch.
